name: safebrowse
description: Filter curse words and profanity, blur likely explicit images, block known adult sites, and enable SafeSearch while you browse.
author: Safe Browse

scripts.build: zip -rFS safebrowse-filter.zip manifest.json package.json README.md src pages assets -x '*.git*' '*.py' '*.zip' '.DS_Store' '*/.DS_Store' 'desktop.ini' '*/desktop.ini'
scripts.test: node tests/regex-safety-tests.mjs && node tests/smoke-tests.mjs && node tests/asset-references.mjs && node tests/feedback-tests.mjs
